name: advance position from the two previous positions and the acceleration
mechanism: new position = twice the current position minus the previous position plus acceleration times step squared; velocity never appears, the update is time-reversible and conserves an energy-like quantity over long runs

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Verlet integration ()' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving: integrate Newton's equations of motion

fails_when: velocity-dependent forces break the symmetry; step length must be fixed
